description: Raw site overview response containing homepage, weather, and component health data. For ordinary user-facing questions explicitly about a default or selected site's identity, location, current overview, status, or health, use get_site_dashboard. Device-focused requests, including device details or device history scoped to a site, should use the corresponding device tool and must not include a site dashboard unless the user also asks for site-level information. Use this tool only when the user explicitly requests the raw overview response or these individual payloads. This tool does not change the site or its devices.
name: get_site_overview
